preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 5,000,000.
The integer k must be between 1 and the length of the string s.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained by partitioning s into at most k parts and reversing some of the parts.
